desc.en: A type of bird that runs around the desert on two legs. Just like the Metal Eater, they changed into their current form by eating minerals in the desert. Their claws and other parts fetch the same prices as actual gemstones.
desc.ja: 砂漠を二本足で走る鳥類の一種。メタルイーター同様、砂中の鉱物を摂取した結果、今の姿になった。爪などが宝石と等価で取引される
